latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing with GPU — fast, cloud-rendered MP4 editing and export.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, up to 500MB) and receive a GPU-rendered 4K MP4 file, ready to download.
- No manual sliders or local setup required — describe your edits in plain language.
- Automatic connection to backend API, using a session token for fast job processing.
- Supports editing, adding transitions, overlays, text, and audio via simple prompts.
- Built-in error handling for tokens, session, format, and credits.
- Exports completed in 30–90 seconds using cloud GPUs.
